result:
I’d make the circumstances of a person’s birth matter far less to their chances in life.

Not make everyone identical or guarantee every outcome. Just make it so that being born into poverty, war, or a persecuted group doesn’t close most doors before you’re old enough to know they exist.

There would still be heartbreak, disagreement, and failure. But more people would get a genuine chance to decide what their lives are for.
